title: Occlusal vertical dimension: treatment planning decisions and management considerations
file_name: Occlusal vertical dimension: treatment planning decisions and management considerations.pdf
key_finding: The review concludes that occlusal vertical dimension is a flexible parameter within a zone of physiological tolerance, to be altered only when clinically needed and by the minimum necessary amount.
clinical_bottom_line: Confirm a clinical demand before changing OVD, keep the change minimal, and use provisionals to test esthetic and functional outcomes.
